## GrowAssistant – Crop Steering v0.1.14

This release updates how GrowAssistant is presented in Home Assistant and refreshes the integration's repository metadata, branding, and documentation.

### Integration classification

- GrowAssistant is now presented as a normal Home Assistant integration in the Integrations UI instead of being classified as a helper integration.

### Branding and repository metadata

- Added standard and high-resolution integration branding icons. The icons will be included with future HACS installs and updates.
- Corrected the documentation URL to <https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering>.
- Corrected the issue tracker URL to <https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering/issues>.
- Added a repository banner and refreshed the README for the current repository ownership and v0.1 feature set, including P3 Emergency, automatic cycle reset, diagnostics, and safety behavior.

### Compatibility

No crop-steering logic, P1/P2/P3 behavior, Blueprint irrigation behavior, pump control, entity IDs, unique IDs, config flow behavior, number ranges, steps, units, or existing safety behavior changed in this release.
